help: capture browser-reachable chats via Safari into data/input/ (a bare `yoga browser` audits capture-health)

args.name: --provider
args.help: restrict to one provider: claude | gemini (default: every provider)

args.name: --mechanism
args.help: restrict to one mechanism: API | DOM (default: every mechanism the provider has)

args.name: --id
args.help: capture ONE conversation (the audit WARNs name it); requires --provider — an id's shape does not say whose it is

args.name: --dry-run
args.help: discover and state the extent (captured / never-captured), then stop — captures nothing, writes nothing

osascript: drives Safari against the logged-in session — navigating, and evaluating JS in the front document (refused loudly under YOGA_NO_SEND)
urllib.request (claude.ai API): fetches conversations over the session's own authenticated API (refused loudly under YOGA_NO_SEND)
fetch (in-page, session-authenticated): claude: GETs each file asset the conversation JSON names (/api/<org>/files/<uuid>/<variant>) that the artifact library lacks — the capture completes the record (#422)
